mapper.delete: DELETE FROM entity_candidate WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND origin_source = 'IMAGE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_candidate (book_id, entity_type, canonical_name, description, confidence, review_status, origin_source) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{entityType}, #{canonicalName}, #{description}, #{confidence}, #{reviewStatus}, #{originSource})

INSERT INTO entity_mention (entity_candidate_id, paragraph_id, image_id, mention_text, source_type, confidence) VALUES (#{entityCandidateId}, NULL, #{imageId}, #{mentionText}, #{sourceType}, #{confidence})

INSERT INTO extracted_fact (book_id, fact_type, subject_candidate_id, value, source_type, status, confidence, paragraph_id, image_id, description) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{factType}, #{subjectCandidateId}, #{value}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{confidence}, #{paragraphId}, #{imageId}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, fact_type, subject_candidate_id, value, source_type, status, confidence, paragraph_id, image_id, description FROM extracted_fact WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY image_id, id
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = 'MULTIMODAL_MERGED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{bookId}
